_comment: Per-scenario clip override for catalog.json. Map scenario_id -> uuid. The uuid is the directory name between <scene_major>/<scene_minor>/<uuid>/<uuid>.mp4 in Dylan's COS bucket. When a scenario_id is missing from this map, sync:cos falls back to the lowest-uuid clip from the bucket so picks stay stable across syncs. Edit this file and re-run `pnpm sync:cos` to regenerate catalog.json. Keys starting with _ are treated as comments and ignored.
_team_status: Team is selecting the best clip per scenario. Populate this file as picks arrive.
